description: G106 AL2: the O1 debit vertical. Long leg = the O1 event's contract; short leg = same underlying, expiry and type, further out of the money, among the window's watched contracts marked at the cutoff. Limits from the legacy DIRECTIONAL_DEBIT_SPREAD block (strategy_o3_credit_v2.json debit_spread, the block the V4 profile's debit-spread groups use).
not_applied_from_legacy: minimum_dte 1 -> 0: O1 packages exit at the session close (a 0DTE vertical at its expiry), like today's single contract; the legacy floor is for multi-day holds (replay Nov 13: 57 of 103 detected events were 0DTE)
minimum_long_absolute_delta / maximum_long_absolute_delta: the long leg is the O1 event's contract, not chosen
maximum_breakeven_expected_move_ratio / maximum_target_expected_move_ratio: need an IV solve at the cutoff (v2)
near/short DTE lanes and maximum_candidates_per_lane_side: one vertical per O1 event
